data.title: Master Word Builders: Prefix, Root, and Suffix

targets.hint: What word describes someone who is not providing assistance when you need it?
targets.definition: Not giving aid or making things easier for others.
targets.sentenceContext: The confusing map was completely ___ when we were lost in the park.

targets.hint: What word describes a fun game that can be enjoyed multiple times over?
targets.sentenceContext: This board game has so many different cards that it is totally ___.

targets.hint: What word means an argument that happens when people do not share the same opinion?
targets.definition: A situation where people have differing views or argue.
targets.sentenceContext: The two friends had a small ___ about which movie to watch first.

targets.hint: What word means the act of handling someone or an animal in a bad or cruel way?
targets.definition: The act of dealing with someone or something unfairly or cruelly.
targets.sentenceContext: The animal shelter protects stray dogs from cruel ___ by neglectful owners.

data.gradeLevel: elementary students (grades 1-5) - Use age-appropriate vocabulary, concrete examples, structured learning objectives, and interactive elements. Build fundamental understanding.
